body:
GREG, 2026-11-09 about 07:06Z, via Asistant 43498a6e #748, verbatim: „Wlącz dla Engram.” Scope per Asistant: Engram only, independent evaluator, other projects unchanged. Applied by Engram::Fable at 07:07:38Z on the Central store, project github.com/grlap/Engram: allowed_modes [independent_session], mechanical_basis asserted, require_source_freshness false, epoch 8, policy 44a3d711. Engram has no store on any other host. So on Engram `done` needs an independent evaluation, and where this differs, it replaces "evaluation is off" in rules-greg-control section 3, rules-greg-broken-evaluation-not-blocker-2026-11-01 and rules-authority-and-landing for this project only. Other projects stay off until his word. Basis: proof w-46e8594c7e7e, one run each way on a test-bound criterion.

WINDOWS B (rev 2, Engram::Fable, 2026-11-27). The WinB Engram store (C:\Users\Greg\.engram, created under „Tak dla Engram na Window B.” #2124) did not receive this policy at set-up: it read epoch 1, allowed_modes []. At Fable's request (relay #58), Fable-WinB (WinB session-27) applied the same policy at 00:23:01.519Z: allowed_modes [independent_session], mechanical_basis asserted, require_source_freshness false, epoch 2, policy c86b1755. This carries out the same word; it is not a new grant. Every new Engram host store needs the same policy before its first evaluated done.
